content.text: Night waking at 8 is less common than in the younger years but it does still happen, often tied to stress, school transitions, or an inconsistent wind-down routine. The thing that moves the needle most at this age is a firm, screen-free 30-minute wind-down before bed — same time every night, no phones, dim lights — which helps her body clock reset within a week or two.
